title: Counter loop machine
statement: Given a deterministic machine $M$ with $k$ work tapes, Boolean work symbols, and state set $S$, a distinguished state $a\in S$, and an optional designated exit state, form a machine with $k+1$ work tapes and states for the body, counter decrement, completion, and escape. It starts in the decrement phase in run mode; in body states it follows $M$ on the first $k$ tapes and redirects successor states according to $a$ and the designated exit, in decrement states it runs the counter-decrement routine on the added tape and routes its exits, and in the done and escape states it stays in that state without moving or writing.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number $k$ of work tapes
A machine over Boolean work symbols with state set $S$
